questiontext.text: What is maintenance defined as in engineering and technology?

generalfeedback.text: Maintenance is defined as the work done on any engineering equipment to keep it in good operating condition.

answer.text: The work done on any engineering equipment to keep it in good operating condition

feedback.text: Correct! Maintenance is defined as the work done on any engineering equipment to keep it in good operating condition.

answer.text: The total destruction of worn-out machines to clear workshop floor space

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance is defined as the work done on any engineering equipment to keep it in good operating condition.

answer.text: The process of operating machines at maximum speed until they stop

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance is defined as the work done on any engineering equipment to keep it in good operating condition.

answer.text: The mathematical calculation of scale ratios using a scale rule

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance is defined as the work done on any engineering equipment to keep it in good operating condition.

questiontext.text: Which of the following is a routine preventive maintenance check that a driver performs before driving a car?

generalfeedback.text: A driver checks the oil level, radiator water, battery, tyres, brakes, etc., in his car to see if there is any problem before hitting the road.

answer.text: Checking the engine oil level, radiator water, battery, tyres, and brakes

feedback.text: Correct! A driver checks the oil level, radiator water, battery, tyres, brakes, etc., in his car to see if there is any problem before hitting the road.

answer.text: Repainting the car body every morning

feedback.text: Incorrect. A driver checks the oil level, radiator water, battery, tyres, brakes, etc., in his car to see if there is any problem before hitting the road.

answer.text: Replacing the entire engine block before each trip

feedback.text: Incorrect. A driver checks the oil level, radiator water, battery, tyres, brakes, etc., in his car to see if there is any problem before hitting the road.

answer.text: Removing the steering wheel to check alignment

feedback.text: Incorrect. A driver checks the oil level, radiator water, battery, tyres, brakes, etc., in his car to see if there is any problem before hitting the road.

questiontext.text: Which of the following is NOT a stated reason or need for maintaining equipment?

generalfeedback.text: The need for maintenance includes avoiding breakdowns, ensuring proper function, reducing accidents, and extending equipment life.

answer.text: To encourage frequent and sudden breakdowns

feedback.text: Correct! The need for maintenance includes avoiding breakdowns, ensuring proper function, reducing accidents, and extending equipment life.

answer.text: To make the equipment function properly

feedback.text: Incorrect. The need for maintenance includes avoiding breakdowns, ensuring proper function, reducing accidents, and extending equipment life.

answer.text: To reduce chances of accidents and ensure safe use

feedback.text: Incorrect. The need for maintenance includes avoiding breakdowns, ensuring proper function, reducing accidents, and extending equipment life.

answer.text: To make the item last longer and save money

feedback.text: Incorrect. The need for maintenance includes avoiding breakdowns, ensuring proper function, reducing accidents, and extending equipment life.

questiontext.text: How does regular maintenance help save money in the workshop?

generalfeedback.text: Maintenance reduces loss of time and avoids premature failures, thereby saving money.

answer.text: By reducing loss of time and avoiding expensive catastrophic equipment failure

feedback.text: Correct! Maintenance reduces loss of time and avoids premature failures, thereby saving money.

answer.text: By eliminating the need to purchase lubricating oils

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance reduces loss of time and avoids premature failures, thereby saving money.

answer.text: By allowing machines to run without operators

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance reduces loss of time and avoids premature failures, thereby saving money.

answer.text: By making mechanical parts wear out faster

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance reduces loss of time and avoids premature failures, thereby saving money.

questiontext.text: Into what three main categories are maintenance types grouped?

generalfeedback.text: Maintenance types carried out on machines and equipment are grouped into predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance.

answer.text: Predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance

feedback.text: Correct! Maintenance types carried out on machines and equipment are grouped into predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance.

answer.text: Manual, mechanical, and automated maintenance

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance types carried out on machines and equipment are grouped into predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance.

answer.text: Weekly, monthly, and yearly maintenance

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance types carried out on machines and equipment are grouped into predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance.

answer.text: Internal, external, and intermediate maintenance

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance types carried out on machines and equipment are grouped into predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance.

questiontext.text: What is preventive maintenance primarily defined as?

generalfeedback.text: Preventive maintenance is the type of maintenance carried out on equipment before breakdown occurs.

answer.text: Maintenance carried out on equipment before breakdown occurs

feedback.text: Correct! Preventive maintenance is the type of maintenance carried out on equipment before breakdown occurs.

answer.text: Emergency repairs conducted after a machine has completely stopped

feedback.text: Incorrect. Preventive maintenance is the type of maintenance carried out on equipment before breakdown occurs.

answer.text: Maintenance performed only when parts are shattered

feedback.text: Incorrect. Preventive maintenance is the type of maintenance carried out on equipment before breakdown occurs.

answer.text: Scraping machine tables with a toothless scraper

feedback.text: Incorrect. Preventive maintenance is the type of maintenance carried out on equipment before breakdown occurs.

questiontext.text: Which of the following is a direct example of preventive maintenance?

generalfeedback.text: Regular oiling or lubricating of moving parts is a typical example of preventive maintenance.

answer.text: Regular oiling or lubricating of moving parts

feedback.text: Correct! Regular oiling or lubricating of moving parts is a typical example of preventive maintenance.

answer.text: Replacing a seized engine after a complete breakdown

feedback.text: Incorrect. Regular oiling or lubricating of moving parts is a typical example of preventive maintenance.

answer.text: Welding together a fractured bandsaw frame

feedback.text: Incorrect. Regular oiling or lubricating of moving parts is a typical example of preventive maintenance.

answer.text: Discarding broken tools into workshop scrap bins

feedback.text: Incorrect. Regular oiling or lubricating of moving parts is a typical example of preventive maintenance.

questiontext.text: Why are exposed corrosive metal surfaces regularly painted as a preventive maintenance measure?

generalfeedback.text: Regular painting of corrosive metal protects the surface from environmental corrosion.

answer.text: To protect the metal from corrosion and rust formation

feedback.text: Correct! Regular painting of corrosive metal protects the surface from environmental corrosion.

answer.text: To make the metal softer for hacksaw cutting

feedback.text: Incorrect. Regular painting of corrosive metal protects the surface from environmental corrosion.

answer.text: To increase the electrical conductivity of the frame

feedback.text: Incorrect. Regular painting of corrosive metal protects the surface from environmental corrosion.

answer.text: To hide mechanical cracks from safety inspectors

feedback.text: Incorrect. Regular painting of corrosive metal protects the surface from environmental corrosion.

questiontext.text: What is predictive maintenance defined as?

generalfeedback.text: Predictive maintenance is carried out using computers and other devices to predict impending breakdowns.

answer.text: Maintenance carried out using computers and other devices to predict impending breakdowns

feedback.text: Correct! Predictive maintenance is carried out using computers and other devices to predict impending breakdowns.

answer.text: Fixing machines immediately after they fail during production

feedback.text: Incorrect. Predictive maintenance is carried out using computers and other devices to predict impending breakdowns.

answer.text: Wiping tools with a damp rag at the end of the term

feedback.text: Incorrect. Predictive maintenance is carried out using computers and other devices to predict impending breakdowns.

answer.text: Manually disassembling entire machines every morning

feedback.text: Incorrect. Predictive maintenance is carried out using computers and other devices to predict impending breakdowns.

questiontext.text: What action is taken once an impending breakdown is predicted by monitoring devices?

generalfeedback.text: Once predictions are made, necessary remedies are immediately designed and applied to avoid those breakdowns.

answer.text: Necessary remedies are immediately designed and applied to avoid the breakdown

feedback.text: Correct! Once predictions are made, necessary remedies are immediately designed and applied to avoid those breakdowns.

answer.text: The machine is operated at double speed until it stalls

feedback.text: Incorrect. Once predictions are made, necessary remedies are immediately designed and applied to avoid those breakdowns.

answer.text: All computer monitoring equipment is immediately turned off

feedback.text: Incorrect. Once predictions are made, necessary remedies are immediately designed and applied to avoid those breakdowns.

answer.text: The machine is discarded in the tool cupboard

feedback.text: Incorrect. Once predictions are made, necessary remedies are immediately designed and applied to avoid those breakdowns.

questiontext.text: What is a major advantage of implementing predictive maintenance on engineering equipment?

generalfeedback.text: Predictive maintenance basically reduces the amount of other types of maintenance carried out on equipment.

answer.text: It reduces the amount of other types of maintenance needed on the equipment

feedback.text: Correct! Predictive maintenance basically reduces the amount of other types of maintenance carried out on equipment.

answer.text: It eliminates the need for machine operators in factories

feedback.text: Incorrect. Predictive maintenance basically reduces the amount of other types of maintenance carried out on equipment.

answer.text: It allows machines to operate without lubricating oil

feedback.text: Incorrect. Predictive maintenance basically reduces the amount of other types of maintenance carried out on equipment.

answer.text: It converts sheet metal into cast iron

feedback.text: Incorrect. Predictive maintenance basically reduces the amount of other types of maintenance carried out on equipment.

questiontext.text: What routine duty must technicians perform to maintain a predictive maintenance program?

generalfeedback.text: It is important to carry out routine checks on the predictive maintenance facilities to ensure they are in place and functioning.

answer.text: Carry out routine checks on the predictive monitoring facilities to ensure they are functioning

feedback.text: Correct! It is important to carry out routine checks on the predictive maintenance facilities to ensure they are in place and functioning.

answer.text: Replace all electrical cables every week

feedback.text: Incorrect. It is important to carry out routine checks on the predictive maintenance facilities to ensure they are in place and functioning.

answer.text: Strike diagnostic sensors with a ball-peen hammer

feedback.text: Incorrect. It is important to carry out routine checks on the predictive maintenance facilities to ensure they are in place and functioning.

answer.text: Wash computer monitoring screens with cutting fluid

feedback.text: Incorrect. It is important to carry out routine checks on the predictive maintenance facilities to ensure they are in place and functioning.

questiontext.text: What does corrective maintenance involve?

generalfeedback.text: Corrective maintenance involves actions taken to correct or restore broken-down equipment to a functional state.

answer.text: Actions taken to correct or restore broken-down equipment to a functional state

feedback.text: Correct! Corrective maintenance involves actions taken to correct or restore broken-down equipment to a functional state.

answer.text: Regularly lubricating gears before any wear occurs

feedback.text: Incorrect. Corrective maintenance involves actions taken to correct or restore broken-down equipment to a functional state.

answer.text: Using computers to forecast potential motor failures

feedback.text: Incorrect. Corrective maintenance involves actions taken to correct or restore broken-down equipment to a functional state.

answer.text: Constructing title blocks at the bottom of drawing sheets

feedback.text: Incorrect. Corrective maintenance involves actions taken to correct or restore broken-down equipment to a functional state.

questiontext.text: Why should workshop managers strive to minimize corrective maintenance?

generalfeedback.text: Corrective maintenance is expensive and disruptive, often requiring total overhauls and replacement parts that take time and money.

answer.text: It requires equipment overhauls and part replacements, costing significant money and time

feedback.text: Correct! Corrective maintenance is expensive and disruptive, often requiring total overhauls and replacement parts that take time and money.

answer.text: It makes tools last too long in the workshop

feedback.text: Incorrect. Corrective maintenance is expensive and disruptive, often requiring total overhauls and replacement parts that take time and money.

answer.text: It prevents accidents completely

feedback.text: Incorrect. Corrective maintenance is expensive and disruptive, often requiring total overhauls and replacement parts that take time and money.

answer.text: It can only be done using a ratchet brace

feedback.text: Incorrect. Corrective maintenance is expensive and disruptive, often requiring total overhauls and replacement parts that take time and money.

questiontext.text: Routine checks on belt tension, chain alignment, and safety guards are examples of preventive maintenance.

generalfeedback.text: Routine checks on belt tension, alignment, wear levels, and safety guards are typical preventive maintenance tasks.

answer.text: true

feedback.text: Correct. Routine checks on belt tension, alignment, wear levels, and safety guards are typical preventive maintenance tasks.

answer.text: false

feedback.text: Incorrect. Routine checks on belt tension, alignment, wear levels, and safety guards are typical preventive maintenance tasks.

questiontext.text: Corrective maintenance is performed before equipment breaks down to keep it in good operating condition.

generalfeedback.text: Maintenance before breakdown is preventive maintenance; corrective maintenance is performed after equipment breaks down.

answer.text: true

feedback.text: Incorrect. Maintenance before breakdown is preventive maintenance; corrective maintenance is performed after equipment breaks down.

answer.text: false

feedback.text: Correct. Maintenance before breakdown is preventive maintenance; corrective maintenance is performed after equipment breaks down.

questiontext.text: Match each maintenance type with its defining characteristic:

generalfeedback.text: Predictive uses sensors to forecast, preventive acts before failure, and corrective restores failed equipment.

answer.text: Uses computers and devices to forecast impending breakdowns
Carried out before breakdown occurs to preserve operation
Actions taken to restore broken-down equipment

questiontext.text: Match each preventive maintenance task with its engineering purpose:

generalfeedback.text: Lubrication mitigates friction, painting stops corrosion, and checking fluids prevents engine breakdowns.

answer.text: Reduces friction and slows down mechanical wear
Shields surfaces against rust and environmental damage
Prevents vehicle engine overheating and breakdown
